basics.type: Private university under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, enacted by Uttarakhand Act No. 12 of 2013, promoted by the Himalayan Institute Hospital Trust
basics.ugc: Recognised under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956
basics.campus: Swami Ram Nagar, Jolly Grant, Dehradun
basics.other: Medical (Himalayan Institute of Medical Sciences, with a 1,200-bed teaching hospital), nursing, pharmacy, allied health, sciences, engineering and management

admission: Class 12 with Physics, Maths and Chemistry/Computer Science/IT, 50% aggregate
Apply online on the SRHU website; lateral entry to 2nd year with a diploma or B.Sc (50%)
Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English; minimum age 17
SRHU Nursing Entrance Examination (NEE-2026), then counselling

scholarships.text: Merit scholarships of up to 100% for Class 12 scores above 90%, with smaller merit scholarships from 70%. A merit-cum-means scheme gives 50% tuition support for family income below ₹5 lakh (minimum 70% marks).

hostel.text: Hostels are available on campus for students.

fees.text: B.Tech CSE costs ₹9,35,640 for four years: ₹1,65,640 for the first semester and ₹1,10,000 for each semester after that.
